title: Recall alert: 228K Toyotas recalled over seat defect - WGAU Radio | Athens, GA
text:
More than 228,300 Toyotas recalled over faulty second-row seatbacks - WGAU Close Hamburger Menu Icon Listen Now Recall alert: 228K Toyotas recalled over seat defect
 Recall alert FILE PHOTO: The NHTSA announced the recall of Toyota vehicles. (speed300 - stock.adobe.com)
 November 2, 2026 at 8:04 p.m. UTC By Natalie Dreier, Cox Media Group National Content Desk The National Highway Traffic Safety Administration announced the recall of more than 228,300 Toyotas because of an issue with their seatbacks. 
 [  Read more trending news  ] 
 The recall affects some 2022-2026 Sienna Hybrid 7-passenger vehicles, the agency said. 
 Read More The second-row seat backs may not remain secured during a crash. 
 Dealers will update the supplemental restraint system electronic control unit software. 
 If a vehicle has a mobility as a service package, then those will get new second-row seat backs. 
 Either way, repairs will be free. 
 Owners will be notified by mail after Dec. 7, but can contact Toyota at 800-331-4331. The company’s internal recall numbers are 26TB24 and 26TA24.
